help:
Usage:
  splicemark start "task description"
  splicemark edit SESSION FILE --lines START:END --expect-start TEXT --expect-end TEXT
  splicemark edit SESSION FILE --chars START:END --expect-start TEXT --expect-end TEXT
  splicemark batch SESSION FILE --lines < splices.json
  splicemark batch SESSION FILE --chars < splices.json
  splicemark note SESSION FILE --lines START:END --message TEXT
  splicemark note SESSION FILE --chars START:END --message TEXT
  splicemark diff SESSION
  splicemark finish SESSION
  splicemark clean

scenarios.title: Multiple writes without line drift
scenarios.description: This demo edits the real FileEditor.js. The upper replacement inserts a line, but the lower target still lands correctly because accepted ranges are applied bottom-to-top.

steps.title: Apply two real source edits in one batch
steps.detail: Input order is top-first. Splicemark rejects overlap, sorts by descending position, writes once, and records each splice separately.

steps.title: Review only this session
steps.detail: The task-local diff contains only mutations attributed to this session.

scenarios.title: Peer work appears only when it overlaps
scenarios.description: Two sessions edit the same real Reconciler.js. Agent B receives Agent A’s attributed edit because their regions intersect. Unrelated sessions stay invisible.

steps.title: Agent A edits Reconciler.js
steps.detail: Splicemark records exactly what Agent A changed under Agent A’s session and task description.

steps.title: Agent B enters the same region
steps.output:

src/Reconciler.js · lines 7:7
@@
-			return 'active';
+			return 'active'; // Agent B touches the same authored region.

[PEER · sm-ce5e6561 · Explain active reconciliation]
src/Reconciler.js · lines 6:7
@@
-			return 'active';
+			// Agent A documents this active path.
+			return 'active';
steps.detail: The output includes Agent B’s mutation plus Agent A’s locally relevant mutation labeled PEER.

steps.title: Agent B reviews its task-local diff
steps.output:

src/Reconciler.js · lines 7:7

-			return 'active';

steps.detail: Routine review remains scoped to Agent B even though both sessions changed the physical file.

scenarios.title: Important notes, not agent chat
scenarios.description: A note is attached to a real PeerRegistry.js region. It stays silent until another active session enters that exact area.

steps.title: Attach an exceptional note
steps.command: splicemark note sm-2912c868 src/PeerRegistry.js --lines 36:36 --message "Keep this return local..."
steps.detail: The note is stored against the current HEAD and code region. It is not a direct message or inbox.

steps.title: Another session enters that region
steps.output:
[YOU · sm-12bd7d5e · Clarify peer return]
src/PeerRegistry.js · lines 36:36
@@
-		return peers;
+		return peers; // The return remains intentionally local.

[PEER NOTE · sm-2912c868 · Preserve peer filtering]
src/PeerRegistry.js · lines 36:36
Keep this return local to relevant peer edits; do not expand it into a global registry dump.
steps.detail: The peer note appears automatically because this edit intersects the noted region.

scenarios.title: A shifted target can still land safely
scenarios.description: Agent A validated a real Reconciler.js line. Another session inserted two lines above it. The boundary remained unique, so Splicemark relocated the single edit by +2.

steps.detail: The intended Agent A target moved, but its content stayed intact and unique.

steps.title: Agent A submits the stale original range
steps.command: splicemark edit sm-72fe994f src/Reconciler.js --lines 3:3 --expect-start "\t\tconst working = this.#matchCount(workingDiff, edit);" ...

scenarios.title: A normal commit retires active authorship
scenarios.description: Splicemark does not replace Git. This scenario edits the real Diff.js, then commits normally. The mutation disappears from the active task diff after HEAD advances.

steps.title: Create an attributed mutation
steps.output:
[YOU · sm-40de4dc5 · Clarify empty diff output]
src/Diff.js · lines 74:74
@@
-				'No active authored changes.\n'
+				'No active authored changes.\n' // Retires after Git absorbs the mutation.
steps.detail: Before the commit, the mutation belongs to the working tree and remains active in Splicemark.

steps.title: Review before Git absorbs it
steps.output:
[YOU · sm-40de4dc5 · Clarify empty diff output]
src/Diff.js · lines 74:74
@@
-				'No active authored changes.\n'
+				'No active authored changes.\n' // Retires after Git absorbs the mutation.
steps.detail: The session-local diff still contains the authored mutation.

steps.title: Commit normally and reconcile HEAD
steps.command:
git commit -am "capture demo mutation"
splicemark diff sm-40de4dc5
steps.output:
[master 48eaab4] capture demo mutation
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

[YOU · sm-40de4dc5 · Clarify empty diff output]
No active authored changes.
steps.detail: Once HEAD contains the mutation, Splicemark retires it from active coordination automatically.
